card.name: Words just before the word count
card.fires_on: The word right before "count(s)" or "counted", such as "blood" in "complete blood count" or "second" in "every second counts". It also fires on "gamma" before a counting detector.

modes.label: Complete blood count
modes.description: "blood" after "complete", where "count" or "cell counts" comes next in monitoring instructions.
modes.example: Monitor complete<< blood>> counts including differential weekly for the first month

modes.label: Every second counts
modes.description: The idiom about urgency, firing on the word before "counts" or "count".
modes.example: This is especially important during severe weather when every<< second>> counts.

modes.label: Gamma counting
modes.description: A radiation-measurement term where the next word relates to counting.
modes.example: are counted in a standard<< gamma>>-ray scintillation well detector.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "count" and its variants as the next word.
card.plain: It spots a phrase that is about to end in the word "count", like a blood count or "every second counts".
